items.period: Mid Western Zhou attribution for the underlying form; the selected file is a modern drawing.
items.tradition: Bronze inscription form; modern vector redraw.
items.caption: This rounded rectangular outline encloses a filled oval in a bronze-script form of 日 attributed to a mid-Western Zhou vessel. The drawing shows the later visible form; it does not establish how the earliest graph was made.
items.alt: A thick, rounded rectangular black outline surrounds a smaller filled black oval.
items.selection_reason: The clear outline and enclosed mark make this attributed bronze-script form useful for viewing 日’s shape. It is a modern redraw, not an image of the vessel, and does not by itself establish the graph’s earliest structure.
items.rights: CC0 1.0, as stated on the Commons file page; Xiaoxuetang query-interface glyph image and attribute data are also CC0 1.0 under its official notice.

limitations.text: This attributed form does not establish when the rounded outline or central mark developed, or the detailed sequence of graphic changes.
